title: Plant Revitilising Mist, Plant Food Spray, For Houseplant and Terrariums Organic - 50ml
description:
Give your indoor jungle a natural boost with our Organic Plant Revitalising Mist. Specially formulated for houseplants and terrariums, this gentle foliar feed is enriched with organic seaweed to support lush growth, greener leaves, and overall plant vitality.


 Key Features:


  Organic formula: free from harsh chemicals and synthetic fragrances
 

  Seaweed-enriched: naturally rich in micronutrients, trace minerals, and growth-promoting compounds
 

  Ideal for houseplants & terrariums: gentle mist for delicate foliage and enclosed environments
 

  Easy to use: simple spray application—no mixing required
 

  Cleaner, greener leaves: supports chlorophyll production and plant resilience
 

 How to Use:


  Shake well before use.
 

  Spray directly onto leaves (top and underside) until lightly misted.
 

  Use once every two weeks during active growth.
 

  For sensitive plants, test on a small leaf first and avoid spraying in direct, hot sunlight.
 

 Suitable For:


  Foliage plants (Monstera, Pothos, Philodendron, Calathea, etc.)
 

  Herbs and soft-leaf edibles grown indoors
 

  Terrariums and high-humidity setups
 

  Seedlings and cuttings (use a lighter mist)
 

 What’s Inside:


  Organic seaweed extract
 

  Plant-derived nutrients and natural humectants
 

  Pure water base
 

 Size Options:


  Available in multiple bottle sizes with fine-mist sprayer
 

 Tips for Best Results:


  Wipe dusty leaves before spraying for better absorption.
 

  Maintain good light and proper watering—this mist complements, not replaces, normal care.
 

  In winter or low-light periods, reduce frequency to monthly as growth slows.
 

 Eco Promise:


  Organic ingredients
 

  Recyclable bottle and cap
 

  Small-batch blended for freshness and quality
 

 Give your plants the gentle, organic care they love—mist every two weeks and watch them thrive.
